read_colmap_model: read a COLMAP SfM model from a folder in binary or text format and return cameras, images, and 3D points
write_colmap_model: write cameras, images, and 3D points to a COLMAP model folder in binary or text format
convert_colmap_format: convert a COLMAP model between binary and text formats using the CLI with input and output paths
get_camera_matrix: get the 3x3 camera matrix and distortion coefficients from COLMAP camera parameters for a given camera model
convert_quaternion_to_rotation_matrix: convert a COLMAP quaternion vector to a 3x3 rotation matrix using qvec2rotmat
